description: Captured synthetic browser/API regression fixture, 2026-10-20. This records runtime variation; it is not independent financial validation.

scenarios.label: Bear
warnings: Terminal FCFF changes by more than 25% from 2036; review the growth and capital-return transition.
Terminal ROIC is below WACC; perpetual growth can reduce value.
This scenario has nonpositive operating enterprise value; no valuation floor is imposed.
Finite continuation includes 10 annual periods after 2036 and assigns zero residual value after that cutoff.
The nonpositive modeled residual is preserved; it is not a limited-liability common-share valuation.
